title: Glazed Fish Curry
description: A sweet and spicy curry dish made with glazed fish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish fillet
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian spices
ingredients.notes: Or use garam masala as a substitute

instructions: Season the fish fillets with curry powder and Saudi Arabian spices.
Heat the glazed sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the fish fillets to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to a baking dish and brush with honey.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with additional glazed sauce if desired.
